instruction: Create a new sheet named "Report" and merge cells A1:E1 to write the header "Investment Analysis Report". Then merge cells A2:A3 to write "Data Summary".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new sheet 'Report' with two merged regions: (1) A1:E1 with 'Investment Analysis Report', (2) A2:A3 with 'Data Summary'. Evaluator verifies sheet exists and both merge regions are correct with expected text.

The logic may fail at runtime or give false positives/negatives depending on openpyxl's behavior
Coverage is complete - all instruction requirements are checked (sheet name, both merges, both texts)
Expected values are semantically correct for the task
